sources.snippet: Bemba ↔ English Translation Models Model Summary Bidirectional neural machine translation models for Bemba (ChiBemba), a major Zambian Bantu language spoken by ~4 million people, and English. These models enable high-quality translation between Bemba and English in both directions, supporting language preservation and digital inclusion efforts in Zambia.
